summary: P01 V2.47.250 fixes maximized-window layout drift across the frontend. At >=1440px, Home, Channels, Watch, Topics, Courses, Projects, Tools and Software browse/manage bodies, the Global Subsite Switcher and Subsite Masthead use one shared 1440px max shell with at least 20px viewport gutter. Navigation centers its Local Rail and Main as one shell instead of pinning the rail to the viewport left while offsetting the body separately. Home receives a proportional wider main/rail composition. Course Reader intentionally preserves a narrower 1320px reading measure. Below 1440px existing desktop/tablet/mobile grammars are unchanged. Stable RPD/SSOT/Functional Contract/Acceptance Matrix now lock the Wide Desktop authority. Exact multi-page shell contracts and canonical regression PASS. No data, schema, auth/security, updater mechanism, provider/server or Production mutation. Production remains Owner-manual.
